title: Crimes Legislation Amendment (Combatting Corporate Crime) Bill 2019
short_title: Crimes Legislation Amendment (Combatting Corporate Crime) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would change laws to better combat serious corporate crime.
It would create a new offence for companies that fail to stop associates from bribing foreign officials and introduce a deferred prosecution agreement scheme.
The bill would replace the existing two-limb test for dishonesty with an objective test based on the standards of ordinary people.
changes: The bill broadens the foreign bribery offence and removes restrictive requirements.
It allows the Commonwealth Director of Public Prosecutions to offer deferred prosecution agreements to non-individuals.
It introduces a new offence for body corporates that fail to prevent an associate from bribing a foreign public official.
It replaces the dishonesty definition in the Criminal Code with an objective test.
summary.affected: Body corporates, individuals involved in foreign bribery, and the Commonwealth Director of Public Prosecutions.
